header: Four decisions that keep maintenance costs low
subheadline: We made these decisions once, so a Desiderio site stays quick to edit and cheap to maintain for years.

items.title: Semantic markup
items.description_text: Landmarks, correct heading order and lean HTML in every element template.

items.title: BEM component CSS
items.description_text: Predictable class names and no inline styles, checked by the audit.

items.title: Container queries
items.description_text: Elements respond to their column, not only to the screen width.

items.title: No frontend framework
items.description_text: Only plain JavaScript, so there is nothing extra to upgrade.
